```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	fig.height = 5,
	fig.width = 9,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE
)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(GGally)
library(patchwork)
library(whychusModel)
```

### River Mile 8.5

```{r echo=FALSE}
rm_8_5_historical |> 
  summarise(min_date = min(date, na.rm = T),
            max_date = max(date, na.rm = T),
            stats = paste0(unique(statistic), collapse = ", "),
            n_NA = length(unique(is.na(temperature))) + length(unique(is.infinite(temperature)))) |> 
  knitr::kable()

```
```{r echo = FALSE}
rm_8_5_historical |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = temperature, color = statistic), alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Whychus River Mile 8.5 Historical Temperature") +
  ylab("Temperature (c)") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    plot.caption     = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

```

### All Historical Forecasts

```{r echo=FALSE}
all_historical_forecasts |> 
  group_by(variable, type) |> 
  summarise(min_date = min(valid_date, na.rm = T),
            max_date = max(valid_date, na.rm = T),
            lead_days = paste0(unique(lead_days), collapse = ", "),
            n_NA = length(unique(is.na(value))) + length(unique(is.infinite(value)))) |> 
  knitr::kable()

```

```{r echo=FALSE}
plot_data <- all_historical_forecasts |>
  mutate(
    month     = month(valid_date, label = TRUE),
    year      = year(valid_date),
    lead_days = factor(lead_days, levels = c(0, 1, 3, 7),
                       labels = c("Hist. Weather",  "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
    variable  = recode(variable,
                       "temperature_2m_max" = "Max air temp (°C)",
                       "temperature_2m_min" = "Min air temp (°C)",
                       "cloud_cover_mean"   = "Cloud cover (%)"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(month, variable, lead_days) |>
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- Colors -------------------------------------------------------------

lead_colors <- c(
  "Hist. Weather" = "darkgreen",
  "Day 1" = "#E24B4A",
  "Day 3" = "#888780",
  "Day 7" = "#378ADD"
)

# --- Plot ---------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = month, y = mean_value,
                      color = lead_days, group = lead_days)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lead_colors, name = "Lead time") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "GFS historical forecast and weather — 44.39°N, 121.41°W",
    subtitle = "Monthly mean by forecast lead time, 2011–present",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "Source: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API (GFS seamless)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    plot.caption     = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

```
